messages.content: audience build kora ki normally kototuko shomoy lage, realistically bolo

Realistically bolte gele eta highly variable, kintu general pattern ta emon hoy: prothom kичhu mash (2-3 mash) mostly slow feel hoy, ekdom kom traction, eta normal ar expected. Tarpor jara consistent thake tader jonno ekta slow compounding shuru hoy - প্রতি mash e ektu ektu kore growth dekha jai.

Real breakthrough usually 6 mash theke 1 bochor er modhdhe hoy, jodi consistency thake. Kintu eta linear na - kokhono ekta post viral hoy hঠাত, kokhono kichu mash e kichu e change hoy na. Jara eta expect kore je 2-3 hopta e boro kichu hobe, tara usually quit kore just tokhon jokhon actual traction shuru hote jachhilo.
